entries.name: chat_api_biometrics_query
entries.description: Query heart rate zones through the real chat streaming endpoint and verify the biometrics tool fires. Pass threshold: 2/2.

entries.name: interactive_workout_edit_retains_context
entries.description: The interactive agent should edit the same workout created in the previous turn rather than creating a new one. Pass threshold: 1/1.

entries.name: interactive_error_recovery_after_invalid_edit
entries.description: After a bad edit request, the next turn should still recover and create a new workout. Pass threshold: 1/1.

entries.name: delegated_complex_workout_generation
entries.description: The delegated complex running workout prompt should complete, return JSON, and validate as a StructuredWorkout. Pass threshold: 1/1.
